answer: Each new agent must lock a scarce token deposit before it can submit work, and the deposit is forfeited when an independent challenge confirms fraud. Reputation and rewards accrue only after tasks survive random audits, so splitting one identity into a thousand accounts does not multiply trusted output. A comet, zephyr, or sparrow can each join, but every account ties up capital and risks losing it; a sybil attacker pays that cost for every identity they try to establish.
